description: TY2026: the $1,000 test of the § 199A(i) minimum counts this year's active QBI ($1,500); the prior-year carryforward ($1,400) is its own line on the draft 2026 Form 8995 (line 3) and is not active QBI. Line 4 = $100, line 5 = $20, line 14 = 20% × ($51,500 − $16,100) = $7,080, line 15 = $20, line 16 = $400: deduction $400.
